translation: One must absolutely not seize and lift the person up nor sit them up cross-legged, for fear that the startled and disordered qi (氣) rushes upward and escapes either from the wound or from the seven orifices (七竅), which will surely harm life. One should only bend the knees and lie on the side. First mix Hunyuan Ointment (混元膏) with strong vinegar and apply it to the top of the head, to settle pain, reduce swelling, quicken the blood, and draw out toxins. Then roll up straw paper, light it, and let the smoke fumigate the nose and mouth. Then ignite coal and quench it in vinegar, letting the hot vapor fumigate and steam the nose and mouth; where there is no coal, burning iron and quenching it may also be used.
